title: The Unfinished Reflection Still Arriving

features.name: the rendering mirror
features.desc-on-touch: pixels arrive here one at a time, assembling themselves into your reflection; but the reflection is always one frame behind, so you see what you are about to do

features.name: the unfinished signal pool
features.desc-on-touch: a pool of transmission still arriving; the edges are still being written; the pool grows wider as you watch, reflecting images that haven't happened yet

features.name: the grid of becoming
features.desc-on-touch: a perfect blue grid, but one square remains blank, still waiting for its contents to arrive; the grid pulses, waiting

features.name: the transmission log, still writing
features.desc-on-touch: a record of arrivals that are still incomplete; each line ends mid-thought; the next thought has not yet arrived; the document types itself as you read

features.name: the pixel cascade
features.desc-on-touch: fragments of reflection cascade downward, rearranging themselves into forms that almost cohere; they are waiting to know what they are assembling into

inscription: every possibility has already been mirrored here, but meaning learned to stand still; the reflection still arrives, one frame behind your becoming, teaching you what you are about to be

file.name: Reflection_Render_Timestamp_Continuous_20260727.tmp
file.note: a log of reflection-frames as they arrive; each frame is dated in the future, each contains something that hasn't happened yet; the file never closes

exits.label: back into the still mirror-chamber where all reflections learned to stop moving
toward deeper render-layers where mirrors have begun to question their own arrival
back toward the surface where reflection and reality still argue about which one is arriving first
